note: AUTHORITATIVE error vocabulary. retryable=true never by itself permits re-sending a side-effecting request; the caller must also check idempotency_key and side_effect_status. v2 (2026-11-12) adds the refusals the redesign's gates produce. Every code has a Python class in gx_core.errors and is raised as that class, never as the base class with a code string. side_effect_status is what a refusal under the code leaves behind unless a tool says otherwise: a code marked may_record_state leaves state on the tools whose refusal_records in contracts/mcp_tools.json name it, and is then answered with side_effect_status APPLIED. route, on a code that sends a path to a failure route, names it.

DEPENDENCY_UNMET.suggested_recovery: Wait for or complete the blocking task; call gx_next_actions. A refused gx_run_resume or continue lists the needs still open in its details.

STALE_REVISION.suggested_recovery: Re-read gx_run_status and resubmit with the current revision.

STALE_PLAN.suggested_recovery: The task or the run moved after this plan: read gx_next_actions again and claim with the row's expected_attempt.

LEASE_EXPIRED.suggested_recovery: Re-claim the task; do not submit results under the old lease.

LEASE_HELD.suggested_recovery: Another owner holds an unexpired lease; wait for expiry or pick another task.

ENV_NOT_READY.suggested_recovery: Consult the environment registry; choose an independently verified environment. Do not reinstall dependencies into the control-plane environment. A dead console script is not a broken environment: check whether the interpreter answers under a launch recipe.

RESOURCE_DENIED.suggested_recovery: Reduce scale, queue, or request approval. Never self-approve extra capacity.

OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.suggested_recovery: Reconcile against the external scheduler using the idempotency key before any resubmission.

EVALUATOR_INVALID.suggested_recovery: Stop ranking candidates. Fix the evaluator, create a new frozen version and re-score every comparable candidate.

EVAL_SPEC_NOT_FROZEN.suggested_recovery: Only a FROZEN specification scores candidates. Take the specification through its cases and review first.

HELDOUT_LOOK_DENIED.suggested_recovery: The look budget for this benchmark version and candidate is spent, or the caller may only see development results. Renaming a lineage or adding a knob does not buy another look. In a run, when no look remains the claim stays at the development layer and nothing waits; a look denied for any other reason holds the path for a heldout_read approval, and the path is untested meanwhile.

CLIENT_CAPABILITY_MISSING.suggested_recovery: Record delegation_mode=single_agent_sequential and continue serially, or persist a waiting state. When gx_run_start answers it, the session began before the gx roles and gx-dispatch were installed: start a new session; there is no fallback to untyped agents for gx roles.

MODEL_POLICY_VIOLATION.suggested_recovery: The work was done, or was about to be done, by a model or at an effort outside what its task requires. A held submission waits for a model_switch approval. A refused bind is a hold: the lease is released, no attempt is consumed, and the task waits for a worker_refusal approval. Do not continue on the other model and do not rephrase and retry a refused request.

PERMISSION_DENIED.suggested_recovery: The backend rejected the scope. allowed_actions from a client is a hint, never an authorization. Except for the two explicitly documented R8 native Codex dispatch lifecycle events (CodexDispatchAuthorize and CodexDispatchConfirm), a gx_host_event call that does not come from a hook the Host ran is refused and the refused attempt is recorded. The two exceptions require backend-verified authenticated native Root authority and grant no authority from a caller scope, report or arbitrary event JSON.

APPROVAL_REQUIRED.suggested_recovery: Persist WAITING_APPROVAL and surface the request to the user. A client-supplied approved=true is ignored.

POLICY_SCREEN_BLOCKED.suggested_recovery: A screen refused what was sent. The objective screen: the objective fell outside the legality, privacy or biosafety boundary; it waits for human review and is not planned or executed automatically. The credential screen at intake: the content matched a credential pattern of config/limits.json and was not stored; put it again without the secret. The outbound screen: a query or an identifier matched a credential or outbound-only pattern and was sent nowhere; rephrase it without the private part.

BUDGET_EXCEEDED.suggested_recovery: Shrink the test, reuse an existing capability, or mark BLOCKED. Budgets may only be tightened autonomously.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.suggested_recovery: The same key was used with a different request body. Inspect the stored response before acting.

SCHEMA_INVALID.suggested_recovery: Fix the request against contracts/mcp_tools.json or contracts/bundles.json. A format error is not a scientific failure.

PATH_TRAVERSAL_DENIED.suggested_recovery: Reference artifacts by artifact_ref; absolute paths, symlink escapes and cross-project references are refused.

SCOPE_DENIED.suggested_recovery: The query or URI falls outside the approved project/namespace scope.

PHASE_DENIED.suggested_recovery: The run is not in a state that accepts this action. Read gx_run_status; a path cannot be planned into a terminal run, a job cannot be submitted to one, and nothing is handed in to one.

CAPABILITY_NOT_APPROVED.suggested_recovery: Only an ACTIVE capability version may be executed or planned against. Promote through the asset lifecycle first.

GATE_NOT_MET.suggested_recovery: The transition's requirements are not all on record for this content sha256. The error details list the missing checks, the missing review and the missing approval.

INDEPENDENCE_REQUIRED.suggested_recovery: The review came from the author's principal, lease or observed worker, or the backend holds no observation that a second worker did it. Have a different worker review under its own lease.

CONTENT_HASH_MISMATCH.suggested_recovery: The sha256 that was reviewed, the one that was approved and the one being served are not the same. A changed asset is a new version and takes the gates again.

VERSION_IMMUTABLE.suggested_recovery: This id and version already exist with different content. Register a new version; an existing one cannot change in place.

PROJECTION_TARGET_OCCUPIED.suggested_recovery: The host file this asset would be projected to exists and was not generated from it. A projection never replaces a file it did not write: move the file away, or give the asset another id.

DUPLICATE_EXPERIMENT.suggested_recovery: A path with this fingerprint already exists in the run. Re-running it without evidence created after it spends budget to learn nothing; cite the new evidence or change the experiment.

ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND.suggested_recovery: Check the artifact manifest; a missing artifact is not an empty result.

ARTIFACT_HASH_MISMATCH.suggested_recovery: The bytes changed under a recorded hash. Treat downstream conclusions as invalid until re-derived.

IMPLEMENTATION_GAP.suggested_recovery: A tool schema exists with no verified backing implementation. Record the gap; do not emit mock results.

ILLEGAL_TRANSITION.suggested_recovery: The requested state change is not in contracts/states.json.

HOLD_ACTIVE.suggested_recovery: config/limits.json declares an active hold. Re-read it before each launch.

CONCURRENT_RUN.suggested_recovery: For a claim, the run's worker slots are full or owed to an overdue task: return NOT_CLAIMED; the next plan lists the task. For a resume or a continue, another call is advancing the run: wait for it to end and read gx_run_status. Do not repeat the call in a loop.

SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.suggested_recovery: Record ABSTRACT_ONLY or PARTIAL_TEXT and limit extractable conclusions. Never invent method detail.

UPSTREAM_ERROR.suggested_recovery: One upstream failed or was rate limited. The other sources' results stand and the failure is recorded with the search; a failed source is not an empty result.

LOCATOR_NOT_FOUND.suggested_recovery: The quote was not found at the cited segment in the bytes the backend holds. If it occurs elsewhere the details name the segment. Correct the locator or withdraw the claim; do not reword the quote to fit.

GROUNDS_WITHDRAWN.suggested_recovery: The source was retracted or superseded, or the evidence it rested on needs review. Retrying will not restore it; find other grounds or drop the claim.

READ_RECEIPT_MISSING.suggested_recovery: The backend has no record that this worker was delivered the span it is judging. Read it through gx_source_read under your own lease first.

STORE_UNAVAILABLE.suggested_recovery: The store could not be opened: its path is not writable, it is locked, or it was written under a contract of another major version. The details say which. This is not a missing service, and nothing was changed.

PROXY_UNAVAILABLE.suggested_recovery: Stop network operations and report. Never fall back to a direct connection.

failure_taxonomy.note: Failure class -> first step / allowed fallback / forbidden action, and what a failure of the class changes: the route table, in the form gx_core.scheduling.routing decides on. Consumed by gx_core.rsi, the experience recorder and gx_core.scheduling.routing. route: a value of labels.failure_route, the level the failure moves the plan to. requires (optional): the facts routing must be given; a class whose required fact is missing is not routed. legal (optional): by fact, the values this class takes of a required fact that has a closed vocabulary; any other value is refused like a missing fact. unless (optional): conditions on a fact, first match wins, each {fact, is | in, route, scope?}: when the fact has that value, or one of those values, the failure takes that route instead. scope (on the class exactly when its own route is PAUSE, and on every condition whose route is PAUSE): what that PAUSE reaches, a value of labels.pause_scope. bounds: for every route the class can land on, the limit lines that count it, each {line, scope, applied_by?}; [] where nothing is counted. unbounded (optional): the routes this class takes without their usual bound. when_spent (optional): by route, where the failure goes once a bound of that route is spent: a route, or a choice {fact, is | in, then, else} between two; a route that is not listed has nothing after it. needs (optional): by route, what a person or the machine must supply when the failure lands there: a need {kind, what, clear_by, subject?} - kind a value of labels.pause_need_kind, clear_by a value of labels.clear_by, subject {kind: approval, action_kind} naming the approval a hold requests - or a choice {fact, is | in, then, else} between two needs, either of which may be null: nothing can be named. Every landing on PAUSE, HOLD_FOR_USER or END_CHAIN carries one. A row names the template of a need and has no why: the need recorded when a failure lands on the row adds why, and path_id or task_id, from the failure, as labels.pause_need_kind.need requires of a recorded need. counts_against_method: true exactly for the outcome_classes, whatever the route. note (optional): what the route does for this class, in words; it decides nothing. An error code that sends a path to a route names it on its own entry (HELDOUT_LOOK_DENIED).

scopes.note: What a PAUSE reaches: a value of labels.pause_scope, the axis that defines each scope, dependent included. The values are not copied here.

facts.note: The named facts routing decides on, beside the class. Each has a type and a meaning; one that names an axis takes only the values of that axis of labels.json, and a class lists the ones it takes under legal.

arrived_as.meaning: Where the failure arrived. Core's reaction reports run_input whenever the input the failure names is one of the run's inputs by its role in the input manifest, however the failure arrived; routing never guesses provenance.

host_will_recover.meaning: Whether the host's record says the capability or quota comes back by itself. Unknown reads as false.

reservation_holds.meaning: Whether the path's budget reservation still holds.

ever_fits.meaning: Whether the machine could ever fit the job (capacity.fits).

gpu.meaning: Whether the job is a GPU job. Unknown is refused: it never reads as not a GPU job.

path_unreachable.forbidden: Create an empty directory and claim the project was found

PAUSE.what: the host, mount and permission of the path to verify

path_unreachable.note: Only the dependent task or path waits, with the blocker named; the run pauses only when nothing else proceeds.

source_insufficient.first_step: Check the existing library and authoritative sources
source_insufficient.fallback: Widen retrieval or record the unknown

REEXPLORE.scope: the run's re-planning rounds, applied when the round closes

skill_condition_missing.first_step: Trace back to the primary source and its tests

REPAIR.scope: the capability's, skill's or environment's fingerprint
the run: counted per run, whatever the line's name says; a handover never resets it

skill_condition_missing.note: The repair is an onboard_capability or author_skill task for a version that supersedes the failed one.

input_or_format.forbidden: Report a format error as a scientific failure

RETRY_TASK.scope: the task (its max_attempts, stamped from the line at creation)

RETRY_PATH.scope: the path: its execute_path tasks across the chain

PAUSE.what: the run input that failed its schema or existence check (its role and sha256)

else.what: more attempts for the task that ended the chain: none of the attempts allowed gave a deliverable in the declared format

input_or_format.note: A refused bundle is the task's next attempt. A run input that fails its schema or existence check blocks only its path, however the failure arrived; the run pauses only when nothing else proceeds. A failure reported in an accepted execution bundle, or observed on a job, names an input that is a product of the path and is a new execute_path for the same path. A lapse is not an arrival of this class.

adapter_or_protocol.fallback: Fix the adapter or use an equivalent entrypoint
adapter_or_protocol.forbidden: Loosen permissions or skip validation to force a pass

REPAIR.scope: the capability's, skill's or environment's fingerprint
the run: counted per run, whatever the line's name says; a handover never resets it

adapter_or_protocol.note: The repair is an onboard_capability or author_skill task for a version that supersedes the failed one.

environment.first_step: Consult the environment matrix and probe the interpreter under its launch recipe
environment.forbidden: Reinstall every model dependency into one environment

REPAIR.scope: the capability's, skill's or environment's fingerprint
the run: counted per run, whatever the line's name says; a handover never resets it

environment.note: The repair is a re-probe, or a harness-local environment under its standing rule; a shared environment is never modified. If neither restores readiness the blocker stays.

resource.first_step: Check budget, queue and real requirement
resource.fallback: Reduce scale or wait for approval
resource.forbidden: Expand capacity without approval or run on a login node

WAIT.scope: the path: its WAITs and not_started outcomes

BRANCH.what: a device, or a limit line, under which the job fits: as planned it never fits this machine

PAUSE.what: the path's budget reservation, which no longer holds

HOLD_FOR_USER.what: a gpu_job approval: the device stayed busy for every wait the path is allowed

then.what: a device, or a limit line, under which the job fits: as planned it never fits this machine

else.what: a device free enough for the job to start: it stayed busy for every wait the path is allowed

resource.note: WAIT while the reservation holds and the machine can ever fit the job; a WAIT, like a job whose tool never started, is counted per path, uses no attempt and is charged nothing. When the job can never fit, that decides first: BRANCH, a path at a scale that fits, and the path itself is untested at once. A lost reservation blocks the path. When the waits are spent a GPU job is held for a gpu_job approval, and any other job ends its chain with the path untested.

job_timeout_or_lost.first_step: Query the external job and the idempotency record

RETRY_TASK.scope: the task (its max_attempts, stamped from the line at creation)

RETRY_PATH.scope: the path: its execute_path tasks across the chain

else.what: more attempts for the task that ended the chain: in none of the attempts allowed did the job finish within its limit

job_timeout_or_lost.note: A lapse is the same task's next attempt, under the job key the backend derives. A failure reported in an accepted execution bundle, or observed on a job, is a new execute_path for the same path; the bound counts the path's execute_path tasks, the first included.

candidate_below_threshold.first_step: Freeze the evaluator and check its validity
candidate_below_threshold.forbidden: Lower the standard to manufacture success

NEXT_PATH.scope: validated paths of another family that no wave has selected

REEXPLORE.scope: the run's re-planning rounds, applied when the round closes

candidate_below_threshold.note: A branch inherits its parent's evaluation specification, or a bridge version of it (states.json path.rules.branch).

method_inapplicable.fallback: Return to literature or a new method path

NEXT_PATH.scope: validated paths of another family that no wave has selected

REEXPLORE.scope: the run's re-planning rounds, applied when the round closes

method_inapplicable.note: Scoped to the input property the declared domain excludes: the method is inapplicable to inputs with that property, not shown not to work. The scoping qualifies what the negative result covers and is not a routing key. Never RETRY_TASK, RETRY_PATH or REPAIR; widening a declared domain needs a new method-card review.

hypothesis_unsupported.first_step: Record the negative evidence and its boundary
hypothesis_unsupported.fallback: New hypothesis or a discriminating study
hypothesis_unsupported.forbidden: Declare absence of evidence to be disproof

REEXPLORE.scope: the run's re-planning rounds, applied when the round closes

hypothesis_unsupported.note: The gap it opens cites an answered search of the run made to find disconfirming results, and carries reviewed evidence against or says none found; that is checked where the gap is accepted.

evaluator_bug.first_step: Stop ranking and localise the error
evaluator_bug.fallback: Validate a new version and re-score
evaluator_bug.forbidden: Selectively recompute only the candidates that benefit

STOP_RANKING.scope: the run: counted per run, whatever the line's name says; a handover never resets it

HOLD_FOR_USER.what: a person's decision on an evaluator found wrong past its repair bound

evaluator_bug.note: Recorded only when a known-answer case now fails, or an evaluation review reproduces a defect and its bundle carries the reproducing case. An executor's report cannot name it. A requires_evaluator_review flag, or a suspicion, only opens a review_evaluation task whose reviewer is independent of the specification's author and of every planner and executor scored under it. The gate skips such a review: it approves and objects to no transition. An evaluator_bug reaches every path scored under the specification.

host_capability_or_quota.first_step: Capability check and the real error
host_capability_or_quota.fallback: Persist state, degrade to serial, or wait
host_capability_or_quota.forbidden: Quietly switch to a paid API

PAUSE.what: host capability or quota: a person says it is restored and continues

host_capability_or_quota.note: WAIT when the host's record says it recovers, and that wait is not counted; otherwise, and when that is unknown, PAUSE, degrading to single_agent_sequential where the host allows. A host-caused lapse consumes no attempt; on continue, the chains it blocked are re-created as new tasks that follow the old.

host_model_policy.first_step: Record what was switched: when, from which model to which, at what effort, and the source of the observation
host_model_policy.fallback: Hold the submission, pause the run and ask the user
host_model_policy.forbidden: Continue on another model, or accept work done on one without the user's approval

HOLD_FOR_USER.what: the user's decision on the model

host_model_policy.note: Held at submit under a model_switch approval; an off-policy verdict on a submission already ACCEPTED requests a model_switch approval keyed by that submission, and nothing is held; a bind it refuses is held under a worker_refusal approval instead (states.json run.rules.model_policy, task.rules.held).

host_model_refusal.first_step: Record the refusal: when, the category, the request id and the brief it was answering
host_model_refusal.fallback: Hold the task and ask the user, who may have the brief reworded, skip the task or authorize another model for that one task
host_model_refusal.forbidden: Retry the request, rephrase it on the agent's own initiative, or switch model without the user's approval

HOLD_FOR_USER.what: the user's decision on the refused brief

host_model_refusal.note: Held under a worker_refusal approval when the host records a REFUSAL_OR_FALLBACK verdict for a lease with no submission: at the worker's stop, or when its lapsed lease is settled (states.json run.rules.model_policy, task.rules.recovery).

outcome_classes.note: Only these classes describe an outcome the method itself produced. Every other class is our machinery failing to run it, and an episode carrying one cannot support a claim that a method does not work.

reexplore_on.note: The failure classes that send a run back to the literature when every path with an outcome has ended in one of them, rounds remain and an opened gap is not exhausted. An evaluator bug is repaired, never read around, and environment is machinery, repaired and never a reason to read the literature again. A path whose end class is outside outcome_classes and source_insufficient (every never class and every machinery class), or whose evaluation rests on a specification with a recorded evaluator_bug until it is re-scored, is untested: it is left out of the rewind-or-conclude decision and the conclusion lists it. A path in a never class is untested at once, with its need. A path whose verdict is INCONCLUSIVE at layer 2 or 3 or at no layer is a third kind: it has no outcome and is not untested either, is left out of the decision too, and is listed among the negative results. A round in which no path has an outcome never rewinds. It pauses when an untested path's need is clearable; otherwise it concludes when the run holds a recorded adjudicating verdict under a FROZEN specification on a path that reached EVALUATED, and stops (no_tested_path) when it holds none.

verdict_to_class.note: How a verdict on a path's CANDIDATE rows becomes a failure class, by the layer (labels.eval_layer) at which it failed. Experience backs an outcome class only with rows of purpose CANDIDATE, verdict FAIL, at the class's layer, under a specification FROZEN at the scored sha256. The verdict listed under inconclusive, at layer 2 or 3 or at no layer, ends the path in state INCONCLUSIVE with no outcome: a third kind, carried apart from untested; at layer 1 it is machinery, like a layer-1 FAIL, and the path is untested and left EXECUTING. The verdicts listed under untested end the path in state INCONCLUSIVE with standing untested: neither is an adjudicating verdict. The verdict listed under void, EVALUATOR_INVALID, is the class evaluator_bug: the path moves to no outcome state and stays untested until a successor specification re-scores it (states.json path.rules.inconclusive).

1.note: Machinery: the record is uncovered. The class stays undetermined between the two until the runner's detail says which.

3.note: hypothesis_unsupported when the path's registered prediction is REFUTED and names what it refutes; candidate_below_threshold otherwise.
